# Louder Sound

> Louder Sound is a comprehensive music journalism platform covering rock, metal, and progressive music through news, reviews, features, and artist interviews.

Louder Sound operates three flagship magazine brands—Metal Hammer, Classic Rock, and Prog—delivering in-depth coverage of the rock and metal music industry including album releases, band announcements, artist profiles, and exclusive interviews with legendary musicians.

## Key Topics

- Metal Hammer
- Classic Rock
- Prog
- Music News
- Album Reviews
- Artist Interviews
- Band Announcements
- Rock Music
- Metal Music
- Progressive Rock
- Audio Equipment
- Live Performances
- Music Features
- Tour Announcements
- Record Players

## Magazine Brands & Core Content

- [Metal Hammer](https://www.loudersound.com/metal-hammer): Metal Hammer magazine section covering metal news and album releases
- [Classic Rock](https://www.loudersound.com/classic-rock): Classic Rock magazine section with interviews and artist profiles
- [Prog](https://www.loudersound.com/prog): Prog magazine section covering progressive rock news and releases
- [About Louder](https://www.loudersound.com/features/louder-about-us): Company information covering Louder's brands and contact details
- [Official Store](https://store.loudersound.com): Official merchandise store for Metal Hammer, Classic Rock, and Prog magazines

## Music & Artist Coverage

- [Music Coverage Hub](https://www.loudersound.com/music): Main music hub covering albums, videos, tracks, and artist interviews
- [Bands & Artists](https://www.loudersound.com/bands-artists): Comprehensive bands and artists section with interviews and biographies
- [News](https://www.loudersound.com/news): Music news hub covering band announcements, album releases, and industry updates
- [Features](https://www.loudersound.com/features): In-depth music features and artist interviews covering rock and metal history

## Reviews & Audio Equipment

- [Reviews](https://www.loudersound.com/reviews): Album and audio equipment reviews including turntables and record players
- [Tech Coverage](https://www.loudersound.com/tech): Audio tech coverage with reviews of turntables, headphones, and speakers

## Entertainment & Culture

- [Culture Coverage](https://www.loudersound.com/culture): Entertainment and culture hub covering films, gaming, and music tributes
